notes.title: Update 1.2. - New Bonus Gallery!
notes.content: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43256193/148567c6c25cc17b77f6c8a03b6a54e6259021c8.png[/img]If you complete one of the 4 endings in the game, you will unlock a brand new bonus gallery accessible from the main menu. The gallery features new and hot naked renders of the main character - Ginny.
